name: Using Custom Blocks
hint: Custom blocks package reusable behaviour and keep a project’s scripts easier to understand.
instruction: Define a custom block for a repeated task and call it wherever the surrounding behaviour needs that task.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
define jump [height]
glide (1) secs to x: (x position) y: ((y position) + (height))
glide (1) secs to x: (x position) y: ((y position) - (height))

when green flag clicked
forever
if <key (up arrow v) pressed?> then
jump (50)
end
end
